title: Security+ vs CySA+: Which Should You Take First?
excerpt: Security+ comes first for most people. CySA+ builds on it for analyst roles.
description: Security+ vs CySA+: what each CompTIA certification covers, who it's for, and which one most people should take first.
body:
For most people, Security+ comes first. It's CompTIA's entry-level cybersecurity certification, and CySA+ is an intermediate certification that builds on it.

## CompTIA Security+

- Covers core security concepts, threats, security architecture, operations and governance
- Often listed as a requirement for entry-level security jobs
- A good first certification if you're moving into security

## CompTIA CySA+

- Focuses on the work of a security analyst: monitoring, vulnerability management and incident response
- More hands-on and scenario-based
- Best once you have Security+ or some security experience

## Which to choose

- New to security: start with Security+
- Already working in a security operations role: CySA+ may suit you better
- Planning a career in a SOC: take both, Security+ first

## How to prepare for either

- Use the official exam objectives as your checklist
- Practise domain by domain and focus on your weakest areas
- Book when you score 85% or more consistently in practice
